description_zh: 一辆试图从右侧超越停止在红灯前的Waymo AV的乘用车，以约1英里/小时的速度擦碰到AV右侧前翼子板的传感器，属于典型的右侧超车空间不足导致的侧碰。

source_snippets: A Waymo Autonomous Vehicle (“Waymo AV”) was stopped in autonomous mode on southbound Escuela Avenue at El Camino Real in Mountain View when it was side-swiped.

The Waymo AV was stopped in traffic at a red light when a passenger vehicle attempted to pass the Waymo AV on the right, and made contact with a sensor on the Waymo AV’s passenger side front fender at approximately 1 MPH.
evidence.reason: 报告明确描述有移动的车辆（乘客车辆）试图从右侧超车并发生侧碰，该车具有测试价值，可设为ego；静止的Waymo AV作为相邻左侧的静止车辆，使用static_hold行为原语，并可利用lateral参数表达侧镜接触的距离保真。
